title: Quenched Canadian Baby Squid Ceviche
description: A bright, dairy‑free ceviche that blends crisp baby squid with a tangy fermented lime dressing, perfect for kids and Canadian taste buds alike.
instructions: Slice the peeled baby squid into thin rings and set aside.
In a bowl, combine fresh lime juice with fermented miso paste until smooth.
Add the sliced cucumber, chopped mint, and black pepper to the lime-miso mixture and stir.
Gently fold in the baby squid rings, ensuring each piece is coated with the citrus mixture.
Sprinkle sea salt over the ceviche and mix lightly to taste.
Transfer the mixture onto a wooden board and let it sit uncovered for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the top and give a final gentle toss.
Serve immediately on the wooden board or with toasted rye crackers for a kid-friendly finish.
